paragraphs: Comprehensive, patient-first dental care for the Independence community, your trusted dentist near Independence, Charlotte, NC.

Welcome to our Independence office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Independence location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off East Independence Boulevard. It offers small-town charm with easy access to Walmart Supercenter and James Boyce Park. We provide care for the Independence community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as East Forest, Matthews, Mint Hill, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!

We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences, and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach, led by our skilled Independence dentist.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Charlotte office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Our office is open Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM and Friday: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do dental offices in Charlotte – Independence accept insurance?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What are your office hours at the dentist in Charlotte – Independence?

Our office is open Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM and Friday: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Is cosmetic dentistry available at the dentist in Charlotte – Independence?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

What should I do if I have a dental emergency after hours in Charlotte – Independence?

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
